props.name: value
props.description: Bold right-hand value — an amount, a price.

props.name: meta
props.description: Muted line under the value — a due date, a timestamp.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Replaces the value column entirely — a control, a badge.

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Tints the row, as the dashboard does for the subscription due next.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the whole row a button. Adds hover and keyboard access.

props.name: valueTone
props.description: Colour override for the value, e.g. a positive amount.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Defaults to `li`, since rows normally sit in a List. Use `div` when the row is already inside an `li` supplied by the caller.
